limits: All eight pairs are authored correlated controls in one Python project, not independent-project accuracy or whole-repository retrieval.
The oracle has three positives, four negatives and one unknown under the exact frozen-source/builtins/no-subclass/no-monkeypatch domain.
Actual scip-python is a Pyright-backed static indexer, not native compilation, ABI or runtime-behavior verification.
Compiler documents omit source text; the source-hash sidecar is curator provenance, not authenticated proof of the bytes read by the producer.
The captured per-document coordinate encoding is unspecified; all selected names are ASCII.
Literal normalization still merges the changed-literal counterexample; unknown Any receivers remain unresolved. No learned threshold or weighted fusion is introduced.

Five fresh-process observations on one ARM64 macOS host retain all raw observations. Leg order is fixed syntax/control/indexed; caching/warming prevents attributing faster later legs to a performance improvement.

CLI wall includes startup/imports/publication; observer wall/CPU excludes those boundaries and index generation. Parent CPU and lifetime RSS do not measure indexer child CPU or incremental context memory.
Tool entry hash and declared producer/runtime versions are provenance, not authentication of the complete installed dependency closure.
Shared-host scheduling and cold-cache state are uncontrolled; raw observations are retained without choosing a favorable run.
